primary_rationale: Multi-task footprint extraction forces the network to learn physical building extents (GSD anchor), which strongly correlates with height. It addresses the failure of generic pixel-to-pixel depth models by treating buildings as discrete objects with geometric area.
physical_scale_source: Learned priors anchored by constant GSD and explicit footprint size mapping.
next_action_proposed: Implement a dual-decoder on DA-V2 (or ResNet) for joint footprint segmentation and continuous height regression.
